hypotheses.confidence_note: Conditional two-second local prototype, not verified world safety. Geometry and residuals are visual model estimates, not calibrated confidence bounds. Road is the approximately straight curb-to-curb paved patch, including both travel directions and occupied parking margins; the narrower target permits only ego-lane center travel. Current speed is 7.7646 m/s, so the 6.5 m/s preference requires gradual deceleration, not an instantaneous speed change. The lead vehicle and approaching car outside the road patch are explicitly retained because they can affect it. Other distant parked rows, sidewalk bicycle docks, parking-lot vehicles, the sidewalk pedestrian and occluded areas are excluded only under the explicit no-entry conditions. Parked-vehicle pull-outs, doors opening into traffic, cyclist crossing the road, oncoming lane invasion and hidden entrants are not covered. No optimization, independent dynamics/collision verification or simulated prefix has been executed here.

premises.statement: The local task domain is this finite street patch for two seconds. Model the observed continuous roadway and all nine listed obstacles in or potentially affecting it. Adopt no new unobserved entrant into this domain, no entry from sidewalks or the right parking lot, and no entry by the farther parked rows. Explicitly listed external moving actors remain included. This is conditional coverage, not a claim that excluded traffic, pedestrians or occluded hazards do not exist. Listed actor source envelopes may extend outside this domain and are supported by their separate unrestricted movement premises.

Adopt approximate passenger-vehicle and service-truck body dimensions as visual scale priors. Estimate native ground centers from apparent body extent, perspective, curb convergence and supplied camera axes, with supplied ego poses compensating the asynchronous camera positions. The approximately straight right and left curb boundaries are estimated at y=-5.4 and y=8.5 over x=-3.5 to21; near-side and rear imagery support continuation around the current footprint. The rectangular road is a cropped straight-road patch, not a widened lane. Its 0.4 m residual includes visual boundary and local planar-appearance error. Flat local pavement and these dimensions are falsifiable assumptions; calibration alone does not establish depth.

The curb-aligned vehicles are conditionally parked throughout the acquisition-to-reference interval and next two seconds, with no pull-out, door opening or pedestrian emergence. Adopted mode holds their native poses. Adverse mode retains a fixed heading differing by up to 0.03 rad, with the same center and dimensions; the enlarged body rectangles cover this heading range.
